name: Rats

variantInfo.name: Rat
notes: 2 Hitpoints, max hit 0, Defence level 1 (all defensive bonuses -42) (npc 2854/2855).

variantInfo.name: Giant rat
notes: 5 Hitpoints, max hit 1 (stab), 4-tick attack speed, Defence level 2 with no bonuses (npc 2856-2864).
Combat level 3, 6 and 26 forms exist; no elemental weakness.

variantInfo.name: Brine rat
notes: Brine rats count for both Rats and Brine Rats assignments.
Requires 47 Slayer and partial Olaf's Quest to access the Brine Rat Cavern. Use the dedicated Brine rats strategy.

variantInfo.name: Scurrius (solo)
notes: Counts towards Rats assignments. Use the dedicated Scurrius strategy and the matching solo or group preparation.

variantInfo.name: Scurrius (group)
notes: Counts towards Rats assignments. Use the dedicated Scurrius strategy and the matching solo or group preparation.

variantInfo.name: Giant rat (Scurrius)
notes: Counts towards Rats assignments. Summoned during the encounter; not a repeatable preparation target.

locationComparison.name: Rat spawns
notes: The Lumbridge Swamp holds the densest giant rat cluster (27 spawns).
Varrock Sewers and the Stronghold of Security also count; multi, cannon and safespot availability are not wiki-confirmed (conservative defaults).

taskNotes: Rats has no combat or Slayer level requirement and is assigned by Turael or Spria (Mazchna does not assign Rats).
slayerTargetId 300 is SYNTHETIC (c2-c3-worklist section 1 allocation contract); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value is a QA live-verify item.
Rat: combat level 1, 2 HP, max hit 0, Defence 1 (all defensive bonuses -42) (npc 2854/2855).
Giant rat: combat level 3-26, 5 HP, max hit 1 (stab), Defence 2 with no bonuses (npc 2856-2864).
Rats are not undead, so the salve amulet does not apply. No task extension unlock exists for Rats.
Scurrius and his giant rat minions count for Rats tasks. Minion kills shorten the number of boss kills remaining on task.
recommendedMethod: Kill giant rats in the Lumbridge Swamp (27 spawns) with any weapon; with 5 Hitpoints and no defensive bonuses they die in a single hit. Ordinary rats in nearby sewers also count. Brine rats also count when their Slayer and quest access requirements are met.
